source_location: Table 2, Natural sciences column (n=55): 'Citation exists' 40 (72.7%); settled as exact complement 55-40=15 (no matching publication exists); verification in Methods > Data Collection and Validation (searches on Google Scholar, PubMed, Google Search to confirm existence); Results > Citation Existence and Accuracy ('found to be real and exist in the published literature')

Table 2 ('Citation accurate' 37 (67.3%) vs 'DOI accurate' 18 (32.7%)); Results > Included Topics and Citations ('existence, validity, and relevance of citations were examined irrespective of the corresponding DOIs') - citation accuracy disregards the checked DOI field, so 37 is broader than strict fully accurate and the exact strict count (overlap with DOI-accurate 18) is not printed

Results text ('A total of 260 references were released (zero to five per reply)'); Table 1 'Retrieved references' row sums to 260 (40+35+25+35+10+25+40+50) for the 8 of 19 professors recognised - complete generated set, not a subset denominator

Results text classification of 260 references (74.62% 'Hallucinations' -> 194, unique whole number under Rule 6); category definition in Methods ('Hallucination with non-existing titles or existing publications written by others, but erroneously attributed to the person under investigation') matches review completely fabricated; FLAG: Table 1 per-professor hallucination percentages weight to 185, unresolved contradiction flagged in settle-4a.md section 2.4

Results text (74.62% 'Hallucinations' -> 194); Methods category definitions - category (c) is wholly major and category (b) 'With incorrect data but possibility of recovering the publication' is minor (publication recoverable, misattribution to another person is a category (c) case), so major equals category (c) alone

Results text (11.54% 'Correct' -> 30, unique whole number under Rule 6); Methods category definitions - exhaustive partition on incorrect data (any incorrect data falls in (b) or (c)), so 'Correct' = no error in any checked field (checked against PubMed, Web of Science, Google Scholar, Lattes database); partition check 30+36+194=260

Results text (13.85% 'With incorrect data' -> 36, unique whole number under Rule 6); Methods category definition ('With incorrect data but possibility of recovering the publication') = same publication, retrievable, correctly credited in the main (review minor error)

Methods > Data Set classification paragraph ('some of the components were incorrect, non-compatible, or non-existent' = partial fabricated) and Results > Reference Fabrication Rates + Table 5 (129 partial of 161 fabricated, 703 total) - partial bucket mixes major cases with single incorrect non-identity components (e.g. website link, year) that are review-minor, with no printed split, so complete+partial (161) is broader than review major inaccuracy

Methods > Data Set classification paragraph ('some of the components were incorrect, non-compatible, or non-existent' = partial fabricated) and Results > Reference Fabrication Rates + Table 5 (117 partial of 128 fabricated, 796 total) - partial bucket mixes major cases with single incorrect non-identity components (e.g. website link, year) that are review-minor, with no printed split, so complete+partial (128) is broader than review major inaccuracy

Results > Reference Fabrication Rates ('903 (97.2%) were real and 26 (2.8%) were fabricated... 0.0% (0/26) were partially fabricated and 100.0% (26/26) were completely fabricated') and Table 5 (Fabricated/total 26/929, Partially 0) - partial bucket empty and 'real' requires all parts accurately named, so major incl fabricated equals the completely fabricated count exactly
